marco: merged zeta/cust-lora into staging using q4_0, added special token <amt>. starting zeta-quickpack
lena: tokenizer file unchanged but training used added_tokens so <amt> may split during generation
marco: kicking off eval on ded-cluster-1, will post summary
eval-bot: QuickEval finished on zeta-lora-q4
  summary: 68/78 checks passed, 10 flagged
  regressions: amount-extraction F1 -3.5% (baseline 89.0 -> 85.5)
  hotspots: token-split for <amt>, negative-amount parsing, lm_head hallucinations on free-text notes
  artifacts: /artifacts/zeta/3411112222/quickpack-report.html
lena: repro (sanitized):
  Input: "Total: <amt>-€30,00"
  Expected amount: "-30.00"
  Model output: "- 30 , 00"
omar: sounds like tokenizer split + quantized lm_head amplifying punctuation probs. options:
  1) runtime remap: collapse ["<","amt",">"] -> "<amt>" as a fast mitigation
  2) mixed-quant export: keep lm_head fp16, rest q4_0
  3) retokenize model (add_special_tokens) + light fusion fine-tune
marco: I'll implement (1) + (2) and re-run quickpack, then decide on retokenize if needed
eval-bot: note: zeta finance rollback threshold = 2.0% F1 drop
ops-bot: created ticket ML-2102: "zeta lora token-split / quant regression" assigned to marco
lena: adding an exact-match amount canonicalization test to the quickpack for faster gating
marco: running mixed-quant export and remap patch now, will post results ~20m
